description: This file contains utility functions and types for launching and managing child processes, including process cleanup, signal handling, and process termination logic within the Playwright project.

methods.name: gracefullyCloseAll
methods.description: Closes all processes in the gracefullyCloseSet set.

methods.name: gracefullyProcessExitDoNotHang
methods.description: Forces process exit after 30 seconds, attempting to gracefully close all processes first.

methods.name: launchProcess
methods.description: Launches a child process with specified options, manages its lifecycle, and provides methods for graceful shutdown and killing.
